# HAR network-log viewer

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/har-viewer/

Inspect a locally selected HAR file by request, status, size and duration, then export a reduced copy with request secrets removed.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Open a synthetic network log and identify slow requests before exporting a stripped diagnostic copy.

## Limits and checks

HAR files may contain cookies, tokens, URLs and response bodies. The sanitizer removes headers, query values and bodies, but review the result before sharing; it cannot guarantee anonymity.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
